decisions.reason: Although it built on our existing capabilities, its disappearance from the website by 2024 signals weak early traction or unsuccessful positioning, so we would redeploy the learning and resources into stronger core offers.
The web tool fits our technical knowledge base, but its rapid removal suggests limited market pull and too little strategic value versus our broader solution business, so we would discontinue it.

We have the absorptive capacity to learn from this related product, but with no visible continuation after 2023 and likely overlap with adjacent offers, it is better dropped and its know-how folded into other developments.
This product is close to our established water-control engineering base, and as a recent 2024 launch it deserves continued commercialization and incremental refinement before any exit decision.

The energy management system strongly matches our strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient infrastructure and can be improved with our in-house R&D and research partnerships, so we would keep it.
This overflow flap gate is tightly connected to our core hydraulic infrastructure business and its dedicated 2024 web presence indicates enough relevance to continue developing and selling it.
